learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.

observations.prediction: Selected Stays equally loud and locked it in.
observations.exploration: At 100 percent air display said Full. Keyboard steps gave 50 then 25 percent, both Quieter. Pump to 1 percent gave Near silence, almost empty jar and sliver sound bar while clapper continued swinging. Let air back in restored 100 percent and Full.
observations.reveal: Corrected to Fades to near silence, recalled the visited 1 percent state, explained molecular transmission and need for material, with faint sound may remain.
observations.visual: Actual dark 1257 by 936 screenshots inspected at 1 percent and reveal after air restoration. Dots, moving clapper, schematic sound bar and radiating arcs changed visibly. Reveal correctly described prior pumped state while current controls showed restored Full. Actual audio was not assessed.
